confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregates (Numbeo-style national figures, Expatistan, Mylifeelsewhere, BeaSavings, Expat Arrivals) with mixed dates, cross-checked against Mexico-wide and Mexico City/San Miguel de Allende figures; they are bounded estimates, not Querétaro menu prices. Cocktail (about 3x beer) and wine (about 2.6x beer) are inferred from the local beer relationship because direct Querétaro data was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation search or live listing was consulted. The FX rate was taken from an RBA-attributed 4.00 pm observation reported in search results, not read directly from the RBA statistics table, so verify it against rba.gov.au before official use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Mexican city priced between national averages (Numbeo and BeaSavings for Mexico, July-October 2026 updates) and Mexico City (higher) and tourist-town figures (Cabo San Lucas, San Miguel de Allende). Querétaro's Expatistan and Mylifeelsewhere data points support fonda and inexpensive-restaurant meals of about $4-10 and mid-range dinners for two near the national figure of about $41-44 without drinks.
